full_transcription.text:
1.  SHAH INFORMED ME DURING AUDIENCE AT NOON DECEMBER 18
THAT GHOLAM HOSEIN SADIQI ACCEPTED ON AFTERNOON DECEMBER 17
THE TASK OF FORMING GOVERNMENT OF NATIONAL UNION.  SADIQI
HAD ASKED FOR TWO WEEKS IN WHICH TO PUT SUCH GOVERNMENT
TOGETHER.  SHAH SAID THIS AGREEMENT WOULD NOT RPT NOT BE
PUBLICLY ANNOUNCED, BUT HE ASSUMED ALL TEHRAN WOULD KNOW
IT SOON.
2.  SHAH SAID SADIQI SHOWED COURAGE IN THIS UNDERTAKING.
CONDITIONS WERE THAT BOTH HE AND SADIQI WOULD ACCEPT THE
CONSTITUTION.  HE WOULD REMAIN AS COMMANDER-IN-CHIEF OF
ARMED FORCES BUT CIVILIAN GOVERNMENT WOULD RUN EVERYTHING
ELSE.  ARMED FORCES BUDGET "WOULD HAVE TO BE WORKED OUT."
HE SAID IT WOULD SPECIFICALLY HAVE TO BE APPROVED BY THE
PARLIAMENT.  (COMMENT:  THIS REPRESENTS SIGNIFICANT CHANGE
IN HIS POSITION.)
3.  SHAH ADMITTED THAT SADIQI WOULD HAVE DIFFICULTY IN
PUTTING CABINET TOGETHER, BECAUSE MOST OPPOSITION
POLITICIANS DO NOT DARE OFFEND KHOMEINI.  HE THOUGHT THERE
WAS REAL RISK SADIQI WOULD FAIL.  IN THAT CASE, HE WOULD
PROBABLY TURN TO BAKHTIAR, WHO HAD SAID HE COULD PUT
GOVERNMENT TOGETHER.
4.  IN DISCUSSING WHAT HAPPENS IF BOTH THESE EFFORTS FAIL,
SHAH LINGERED LONG ON THE REGENCY COUNCIL PROPOSALS THAT
HAD BEEN MADE TO HIM BY SANJABI AND ALI AMINI.  HE REJECTED
SANJABI'S IDEA OF HIS LEAVING THE COUNTRY OUT OF HAND, BUT
KEPT COMING BACK TO THE ALI AMINI IDEA OF A COUNCIL WHICH
WOULD BE FORMED WHILE HE WAS STILL IN COUNTRY, AND STILL
ACTING AS COMMANDER-IN-CHIEF OF ARMED FORCES.  HE FINALLY
SAID HE WOULD RATHER QUIT THAN "BE CLIPPED LIKE A BIRD AND
PUT IN A CAGE."
5.  WE THEN TURNED TO DISCUSSION OF NIOC AND CENTRAL BANK.
HE SAID HE EXPECTED ENTEZAM TO TAKE NIOC JOB AS FIGURE-
HEAD, WITH MINA AND NABEGH RUNNING THE COMPANY.  AS FOR
CENTRAL BANK, MEHDI SAMII WOULD EVENTUALLY TAKE OVER,
BUT NOT IMMEDIATELY, UNDER THREAT OF STRIKERS.
6.  IN DISCUSSING TODAY'S GENERAL STRIKE, HE SEEMED WELL
INFORMED IN GREAT DETAIL ABOUT OIL PRODUCTION, IRAN AIR,
THE CENTRAL BANK, ETC.  HE ALSO SEEMED TO HAVE A MORE
ACTIVE INTEREST IN GOVERNMENTAL FUNCTIONS THAN I HAVE
RECENTLY OBSERVED.  IN GENERAL, HE SEEMED LESS DEPRESSED
AND MORE CONFIDENT THAN HE HAS BEEN IN RECENT TIMES.  HE
EXPRESSED GREAT CONFIDENCE IN SADIQI.  SULLIVAN

query: The Shah could remain commander in chief under a civilian government, but opposition politicians would hesitate to join a cabinet for fear of offending Khomeini.
